notes.title: 💥 Soulslinger 1.0 is Here: Enter the Realm of Trauma and Face Victor Himself!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44325770/00325ac0227f33819fb9fd3e9fcc5760d628a0f9.jpg[/img]

Heya Soulslingers!

It’s official — [b]Soulslinger: Envoy of Death[/b] has left Early Access and launched into version 1.0! After four years of development, your journey through the afterlife reaches its most intense and personal chapter yet. And trust us, this update is massive!

[h3][b]💀 New Realm: Trauma[/b][/h3]
Step into Trauma, the darkest and most dangerous realm yet. Twisted memories, shattered souls, and haunting fragments of the past swirl together in this new endgame zone. It’s a brutal, atmospheric gauntlet designed to test everything you’ve learned so far. Only the strongest Soulslingers will survive.

[h3][b]🧨 Face the Final Villain: Victor[/b][/h3]
At the heart of Trauma, you’ll face Victor — the elusive and powerful mastermind behind the soul-corrupting horrors you've been fighting all along. This is the ultimate showdown, and it introduces brand-new, never-before-seen mechanics that will challenge even the most seasoned players. Victor isn’t just another boss — he’s the boss.

[h3][b]🚨 Launch Sale — 50% OFF![/b][/h3]
To celebrate the full release, Soulslinger: Envoy of Death is 50% off for the first 14 days!

🗓️ Starts: Thu, Apr 17
🗓️ Ends: Thu, May 1
💸 Launch Price: 8.99€ (down from 17.99€)

After the launch sale ends, the base price of the game will increase to 19.99€, so this is truly the smartest time to jump in, or to grab a gift for your favorite rogue-loving friend.

[h3][b]🎁 And Much More...[/b][/h3]
Version 1.0 includes plenty of quality-of-life improvements, bug fixes, visual polish, and additional lore to uncover. Here's the full changelog:


[h3][b]CHANGELOG FOR VERSION 1.0[/b][/h3]


[b]NEW FEATURES[/b]
[list][*] New realm: 'Trauma' with four new, incredibly challenging enemies
[*] New boss: 'Victor' can be defeated at the end of the Trauma realm
[*] New weapon: the 'Phantom Triad' can be unlocked in the middle of the Forgotten Graveyard realm
[*] New crafting category: when crafting 'Tomes', new perks and ultimate abilities are unlocked for each essence
[*] Added a brand new game mode 'Trail of Ghosts', an endless survival mode with new and unexpected challenges
[*] Added new conversations with NPCs in Haven that wrap up the story of most characters
[*] Added new items to purchase from the pirate vendor
[*] Added 20 new achievements
[*] Redesigned gamepad controls from scratch for the main menu, in-game menu, workshop and totem screens[/list]
[b]BALANCE[/b]
[list][*] Bullets of Vitality are now limited to only healing once (even if it kills multiple enemies with one shot)
[*] Bullets of Vitality are now affected by healing power
[*] Increased the chance of a Healing Shrine spawning from 30% to 50%
[*] The 'Fond Memory' Nia Blessing now gives 15% bonus attack each time an active ability is used, and is reset at the end of the battle
[*] The 'Initiative' Nia Blessing now deals 200% damage instead of 250%
[*] Increased the health bonus provided by the 'Essence of Life' Blood Essence perk from 10 to 20.
[*] Enemies are much tougher in difficult mode
[*] Wraiths (Land of Memories secret challenge enemies) have more health and more of them appear now[/list]
[b]IMPROVED FEATURES[/b]
[list][*] Vastly improved enemy pathfinding
[*] Improved the Land of Memories challenge arena collisions to allow free movement and a more challenging fight against Wraiths
[*] Added gameplay option to disable headbob[/list]
[b]BUGFIXES[/b]
[list][*] Fixed a bug where the Bestiary icon was not removed after visiting the Bestiary
[*] Fixed a bug where in the temple arena, enemies would get stuck on the top of a rock
[*] Fixed a bug where Wraithshot bullets would stop dealing damage to bosses
[*] Fixed a bug where Wraithshot bullets would not be piercing enemies after a while
[*] Fixed a bug where the Cursed King's rotating markers would remain on the battlefield after the bossfight
[*] Fixed a bug where time would remain slowed down during a cut-scene if any time altering abilities were in effect
[*] Fixed a bug where the healing shrine sound would not stop upon exiting to the main menu
[*] Fixed a bug where you could glitch through the cave ceiling in one of the Land of Memories maps
[*] Fixed a bug where the King's Guard would get stuck on top of the warp gate or one of the rock edges
[*] Fixed a bug where the decorative bars in the secret challenge arena would block enemy attacks
[*] Fixed a bug where the Contagion perk would restart the poison delay on already poisoned enemies
[*] Fixed a bug where the heat gauge would be visible when using the Silver Defiler[/list]

Thank you to every single Soulslinger out there who’s joined us during Early Access — your feedback, passion, and support helped shape this final release. This is your story as much as it is ours.

We’ll see you in limbo... and far beyond.

🔥 Lock and load,
The Elder Games Team

notes.title: 🔥 Soulslinger Full Launch is planned for April 17!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44325770/80d506552f539198210610b949078ec728bfd037.jpg[/img]

Heya Soulslingers!

The wait is over! [b]Soulslinger: Envoy of Death[/b] is leaving Early Access and stepping into its [b]full release with Update 1.0 on April 17[/b]! This update is packed with new content and the long-awaited conclusion to Soulslinger’s journey. Let's dive right in!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44325770/98ead5d553c6fba0bb2db85583c2201c6d8c6a73.png[/img]

[h3][b]Enter Trauma[/b][/h3]

Brace yourself for the Trauma realm! Within its depths, you’ll face four new, incredibly challenging enemies, each embodying one of the first four stages of grief: Denial, Anger, Bargain and Depression. All four are much more powerful than any enemy you’ve faced before. For instance, Anger is an explosive powerhouse with devastating area-of-effect attacks that can wipe out the unprepared whereas Depression is unlike any enemy before, as it doesn’t attack. Instead, it slows you to a crawl with its oppressive aura, making escape almost impossible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44325770/6426a71539decfa5eef855eb70f4a6b6cb41f805.png[/img]
Survive these manifestations of grief, and you'll earn the right to face the ultimate adversary...


[h3][b]Victor Awaits[/b][/h3]

At the end of the Trauma realm, the battle you've been waiting for finally arrives. Victor, the enigmatic mastermind pulling the strings, is now a full-fledged boss fight, featuring never-before-seen mechanics that will test your skill, strategy, and determination. This is the final confrontation – do you have what it takes to take him down?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44325770/061f716024eb12af0c09496872e4f16b9290c6df.png[/img]

[h3][b]Introducing Craftable Tomes[/b][/h3]

A brand-new crafting category is here! Tomes unlock new perks and ultimate abilities for each Essence, breathing new life into your combat strategies.

[list][*] [b]Tome of Fire[/b] – Unleash devastating fire-based abilities that make it much easier to set enemies on fire, as well as the Firestorm ultimate ability.
[*] [b]Tome of Lightning[/b] – Harness the storm to stun enemies much longer, and also unlock the Tempest’s Wrath ultimate ability.
[*] [b]Tome of Blood[/b] – Turns the Blood Essence into a powerful tool for survival, making health regeneration more viable than ever.
[*] [b]Tome of Poison[/b] – Inflict slow, painful damage with enhanced toxin-based attacks, and unlock the Plague’s Embrace ultimate ability.[/list]
In addition to the new perks, you can also combine the new utlimate abilities with the Bloodshed ultimate ability, creating some of the most powerful abilities in the entire game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44325770/faac72d3b937417fa43c0c659a97d61e1f57d90a.png[/img]

[h3][b]Trail of Ghosts Mode[/b][/h3]

Looking for the ultimate test of endurance? The new Trail of Ghosts mode is an endless survival challenge where waves of enemies grow stronger with each round. The deeper you go, the greater the rewards – but beware, Victor's Army won’t be your only concern. Expect bosses and elite enemies to show up in overwhelming numbers, making every second a fight for survival. How long can you last?


[h3][b]A Fitting End[/b][/h3]

The stories of Death, Helene, Lady Valerie, Victor, and of course, Soulslinger himself are finally coming to a close. New conversations in Haven wrap up their arcs, bringing surprise twists and an emotional conclusion to your journey through the afterlife. If you've been invested in their fates, now’s the time to see how it all ends.


[h3][b]Soulslinger 1.0 – The Journey Comes Full Circle[/b][/h3]

This is it, Soulslingers – the full release of the game you've helped shape with your feedback and support. From new enemies and realms to groundbreaking new game mechanics, Update 1.0 is our love letter to you, the players. Thank you for being part of this journey with us. 

--Ede out

notes.title: 🔥 Soulslinger Update 0.741: Unleashing Performance!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44325770/883db3bb02373794f87cdd2887757ea35a00006b.jpg[/img]

Heya Soulslingers!

Sharpen your aim and brace for the best version of Soulslinger yet! You told us the game's optimization wasn't where it should be, and we listened. We've worked a lot to ensure your journey through the realms of limbo is much smoother! With this major optimization patch, we've vastly improved the game's performance, delivering a 2-3x boost in speed and fluidity. Both player and enemy bullets have undergone a major overhaul, now consuming minimal resources.

We've also tackled some of the more challenging bugs, from optimizing the physics of destructible crates to refining enemy behavior.

Ready to feel the difference? Dive back into the afterlife and let us know how it works for you!


[h3][b]CHANGELOG FOR VERSION 0.741:[/b][/h3]

[b]IMPROVED FEATURES:[/b]
[list][*] Vastly improved performance, the game should overall perform 2-3x faster than before
[*] Optimized all bullets (both player & enemy bullets)
[*] Fixed a performance issue where the bullets of Keeper of Fire and Devourer enemies were not initialized correctly
[*] Performed a major optimization related to the physics of destructible crates[/list]
[b]BUGFIXES:[/b]
[list][*] Fixed a bug where weapon pickups were sometimes automatically picked up when approaching them
[*] Fixed a bug in the Outskirts where an enemy could spawn within a rock wall
[*] Fixed a bug where the Stormcaller Revenant's indicator circle would remain on the battlefield after its death
[*] Fixed a bug where the Blightbone Sapper in the second realm would be classified as 'spectral' and therefore suffer all debuffs of spectral enemies
[*] Marker for the Bestiary in Haven will now be removed once it's been visited
[*] Fixed a bug where you could unlock a Well of Tears upgrade even with insufficient resources if you had the resources in a previous visit to the Well
[*] Fixed a bug where the effect of Bullet of Vitality would remain even if replacing it with another bullet effect
[*] Fixed a bug where the pirate vendor's exit gate wouldn't open in the Outskirts realm[/list]

So long, friends!
Ede out!

notes.title: MINOR UPDATE - VERSION 0.726
notes.content:
NEW FEATURES:
- Redesigned the 'Vengeance' gun, it is now called 'Hexweaver' and is charged if you use your active abilities
- The Hexweaver is now available by default

BALANCE:
- The Hexweaver deals 12 damage (instead of 7)
- The Night Quartet deals 35 base damage (instead of 27)
- Increased the base damage of the Soul Revolver (15->20) and Double-Barreled Fury (45->50) weapons
- Silver Defiler is now available after beating the King's Guard for the first time
- The Wraithshot is available upon entering the Outskirts
- All destructible crates are now outlined to make them easy to identify even from a distance
- Removed the Unclouded Eye relic and enabled outlines for all enemies by default

- Optimized the King's Guard bossfight to prevent any stuttering

- Vastly optimized rendering, the game should perform much better on lower-end hardware
- Improved level loading to eliminate stuttering that stems from loading maps

- Fixed a bug where a charged Hexweaver would not work with Quicksand Shots
- Fixed a bug where Soulslinger's hands were glitched in cut-scenes
- Fixed a bug where the Pirate's healing power purchase displayed the wrong value
- Fixed a bug where the shotgun would remain opened after casting a spell while reloading
- Fixed a bug where shadow damage was not dealt despite picking up the associated perk
- Fixed several bugs in the new arenas where enemies would spawn atop unreachable walls
- Fixed a bug where the electric bullet would not reduce ultimate ability cooldowns

notes.title: 🔥 Update 0.718: New Arenas, Improved Weapon Handling, Polished VFX, And More!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44325770/02af9441c9b1610de77dc7b2a0d4d45554d0d7cc.jpg[/img]

Greetings Soulslingers!

As announced last week, [b]update 0.718[/b] for [b]Soulslinger: Envoy of Death[/b] is now available! This update in general is about listening to your feedback, and make the game the most enjoyable experience possible.

As of now you can interrupt reloading and swap weapons, the weapon handling, accuracy and animations were improved vastly, new arenas have been added to the Land of Memories and the Outskirts, new conversations with NCPs have been added in Haven, and VFX got polished and cleaned up or removed (when unncessary). Furthermore we've added new, higher quality ones for the sake of easier readability (clarity) of the battlefield.

[b]The 0.718 update brings many more new features, balance changes, improved features and bugfixes; here is the complete changelog:[/b]


[b]NEW FEATURES:[/b]
[list][*] Added new arenas to the Land of Memories and the Outskirts
[*] You can now interrupt reloading and swap weapons
[*] Added new conversations with NCPs in Haven
[*] Added the Credits video to the main menu
[*] Weapon FOV is now independent from the game and respects ultrawide resolutions as well
[*] Added new sound effects for Voidcasters, Void Harbingers, Bandits and the Revenant Sheriff[/list]
[b]BALANCE:[/b]
[list][*] Significantly reduced the health of the Sentinel boss to make it less repetitive / easier to beat
[*] Reduced the amount of enemies and damage dealt during a Victor's Army rush
[*] Reduced the health of Victor's Army
[*] Reduced the amount of enemies spawning in the Outskirts during a fight
[*] Slowed down all enemy projectiles of enemies native to the Land of Memories
[*] Slowed down the Cartel Brute's projectile attack
[*] Even imbued shots can recharge ultimate abilities now[/list]
[b]IMPROVED FEATURES:[/b]
[list][*] Vastly improved weapon handling
[*] The crosshair now responds to what type of object you're pointing at (turns red in case of an enemy or explosive, turns brown in case of a crate)
[*] Reduced the recoil camera shake
[*] Replaced the visual effect of the Devourer attack (the difficult mode ghost) to make it clearer
[*] Added a guide particle effect to the chase map so it is immediately obvious what path you must take to reach the end
[*] Added an option to disable the camera dust post-processing effect
[*] Enemy death animations are much faster and do not have the spark effects anymore
[*] Reduced the size of enemy projectiles or completely replaced their VFX for higher quality and better readability
[*] Reduced the size and brightness of the electric dash/stun reload VFX
[*] Replaced numerous visual effects for the sake of much better visual clarity during battle
[*] Cleaned up collisions in ALL battle arenas, movement should be much smoother in general
[*] Replaced the "Loading" texts with more immersive, world-specific texts
[*] All of Death's clothing now has proper physics, preventing weird stiff cloth pieces
[*] Optimized the game's memory footprint for less RAM usage
[*] Adjusted/fixed the volume of weapon sounds[/list]
[b]BUGFIXES:[/b]
[list][*] Fixed a bug where shots were fired slightly below the crosshair
[*] Fixed a bug where the electric bullet damage was not calculated based on the base weapon damage
[*] Fixed a visual bug with the Wraithshot weapon pickup
[*] Fixed a bug where shadow marks were not visible on enemies
[*] Fixed a bug where battle shrines were visible when loading a saved game
[*] Fixed a bug where the character's hand would be floating next to the shotgun
[*] Fixed a bug where it was possible to get stuck in the place where a Windcaller Scout was killed
[*] Fixed a bug where enemies kept burning even after dying
[*] Fixed a bug which caused shots to be inaccurate if firing rapidly
[*] Fixed a bug where the dash input would sometimes not register, especially when dashing sideways
[*] Fixed a bug where crates would be floating above the ground
[*] Fixed a bug where the battle shrine would hide the ability icon from the bottom-right when upgrading a skill
[*] Fixed a bug where replacing the currently equipped Wraithshot would cause the bullet ability to remain inactive
[*] Fixed a bug where the second ability (spell) was cancelled because of switching weapons
[*] Fixed a bug where the Sentinel would just get stuck and not fight
[*] Fixed a bug where opening the Workshop while leaving Haven would lock the game
[*] Fixed a bug where using melee while aiming down sights would cause weird animations
[*] Fixed a bug where dealing melee damage to bosses could cause them to get locked in place[/list]

So long, friends!
Ede out!

Heya Soulslingers!

Get your guns ready and set foot into Soulslinger's [u][b]largest Early Access update to date[/b][/u]!

The new boss 'Sentinel' is waiting to be defeated at the end of the 'Outskirts' realm, you can find the ‘Wraithshot’ schematics to add a powerful addition to your weapon arsenal, and finally get introduced to the game's main villain, Victor!

But that's not all, of course! The major update introduces new 'Rush Encounters', adds five new, elite enemy types, a new relic, the final Well of Tears upgrades, and not least lots of new conversations back at Haven that provide you with more lore and story details.

So, what are you waiting for? Death is calling you back to arms!

[b]And without further ado, this is the complete changelog for version 0.658:[/b]


[b]NEW FEATURES:[/b]
[list][*] The second half of the 'Outskirts' realm has been added with new arenas and new enemies
[*] Added a massive new cinematic right after beating the Revenant Sheriff, this introduces 'Victor', the main villain of the game
[*] Added a new weapon: the ‘Wraithshot’ schematics can be found upon defeating the 'Revenant Sheriff' boss
[*] Introduced 'Rush Encounters', these become available after meeting Victor
[*] Added five new, elite enemy types summoned by Victor during Rush Encounters
[*] Added a new boss: the 'Sentinel' can be defeated at the end of the 'Outskirts' realm
[*] New relic: the Scroll of Wealth schematics can be purchased from the pirate vendor, causes coins to stay on the ground longer

[*] Added Battle Shrines to the game, these offer unfair temporary advantages in exchange for sacrificing health[/list]

[*] All Death Offers are now more powerful or have less severe downsides (excluding Reaper's Resilience)
[*] Slightly increased the Night Quartet's cooldown cost

[b]IMPROVED FEATURES:[/b]

[*] Optimized the performance of the electric dash/stun reload visual effect
[*] Added the segment info (the one you see on the loading screen) to the character screen as well
[*] Replaced the melee animation with a more impactful punch[/list]

[list][*] Fixed a bug where the Blood Rune would not become usable again if it was reset after traveling through a gate

[*] Fixed a bug where entering the Countess bossfight would reset the current save to the Land of Memories immediately

So long, friends!

notes.title: New Early Access Update releasing this Week: New Weapon, new Enemies, new Boss!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44325770/9377f71182d09b78a579f8a3b0ff458fc41c43be.jpg[/img]

Heya Soulslingers!

In just a few days, [b]Soulslinger: Envoy of Death[/b] will receive its largest update yet, and we can't wait for you to dive in! The second half of the Outskirts realm will finally arrive, packed with treacherous new arenas, a host of never-before-seen enemies, and surprise encounters that break up regular gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44325770/9247597468ec28a3250e709059fb2f5c11b2a855.jpg[/img]

We’re also introducing a brand-new weapon — the Wraithshot. A powerful addition to your arsenal, the Wraithshot schematics can be found after defeating the Revenant Sheriff boss. This gun is devastatingly strong, but its strength is balanced by the fact that it needs to be reloaded after each shot. But if that shot is used well, it can tear through the entire battlefield!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44325770/3245383520ff8b3b6a2f00433ccbb0f9d2f0a8d9.jpg[/img]

But that’s not all. We’re thrilled to finally introduce the game's main villain, Victor. With him comes a brand-new challenge: Rush Encounters. Victor intervenes in regular battles, summoning five elite enemy types, each more brutal than the last. These enemies can phase through walls and unleash devastating area-of-effect attacks, ramping up the intensity like never before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44325770/7a2d08848b71767eccbff156bf46ae4519726514.jpg[/img]

Lastly, prepare to confront one of your deadliest opponents yet — the nightmarish Sentinel. This grotesque boss awaits you at the end of the Outskirts realm, wielding soul-devouring powers that pose an entirely new kind of threat. Do you have what it takes to bring it down and survive?

And this is just the tip of the iceberg — it’s not even a quarter of the changes and new features coming your way! After four months in the making, we at Elder Games are beyond excited to finally bring you this massive update!

So long, friends!
Ede out!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44325770/a752d033f7061c0eb94a6444e6141413d80be22e.jpg[/img]

Howdy Soulslingers! 

New unexplored lands have just shown up in Limbo, and now Death needs your help, Soulslingers, to vanquish the Cartel lurking in the Outskirts! To help you on your way, you are given a new weapon, ‘Silver Defiler,’ and a new set of skills, 'Desolate Essence,'  that might prove useful.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44325770/da2f04f2b0d938fcbe6aa6806d9a1ea4aa86f034.png[/img]
[b]Welcome to the Outskirts![/b]
With one part of Limbo relatively safe, Death sends Soulslinger deeper into Cartel territory to hunt another lieutenant. The landscape shifts even further into that of the Wild West, reflecting the Cartel’s leader’s solid hold on the area. These are the 'Outskirts' - the outer rim of Cartel territory, dominated by deadly gunslingers and monstrous wraiths. 

[b]Silver Defiler[/b]
A weapon with a curved projectile that creates a poisonous puddle on the ground upon impact, causing devastating AOE damage to all enemies in the area. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44325770/d3822a1b62ccba1c541db20be59231ad9021db61.png[/img]
[b]Desolate Essence[/b]
With the Desolate Essence, you can summon an allied golem that will rush to the closest target and aid you for a limited time. Or you can lower your dash cooldown so you can move around a lot quicker.  

[b]Revenant Sheriff and new enemies[/b]
A new challenge awaits you when venturing around in the Outskirts with five new types of enemies. You will also encounter the Revenant Sheriff, who might stop you in your tracks as you travel deeper into Limbo!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44325770/c09a373735864a7e8a2f15c4bae13517127867eb.jpg[/img]

Heya Soulslingers!

A Soulslinger Early Access roadmap update was originally planned for June, but we've decided to postpone it until the beginning of July. For the amount of content that is coming with the update, we just need the extra time to be able to deliver it all at the usual quality.

We have adapted the Early Access Roadmap artwork on the product page accordingly.

Happy Friday, Soulslingers!

As promised in yesterday's teaser post, we have released the [b]update 0.452[/b], introducing new ways to upgrade and handle weapons. You will now be able to use two weapons and easily swap between them with the (TAB) key even during a fight, and every weapon now has unique weapon-specific perks and levels, creating new ways for you to play the game! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44325770/6e9dd4c1fa5fc207fb1317459ed56a91edb5add5.jpg[/img]
We also made it easier to obtain the 'The Night Quartet' and, as a result, have added a new Relic that will be awarded by defeating the Countess. 

With this update, we are also bringing a lot of quality-of-life changes and improvements to FOV, VFX, and much more that the community has put forward. We thank you for your support. Please let us know what you think about the new changes!

[b]NEW FEATURES AND IMPROVEMENTS:[/b][list]
[*]You can now carry up to 2 weapons
[*]You can now find weapons out in the game world; their level, damage, and bonus stats are randomized
[*]The Night Quartet weapon can now be found by just entering the Forgotten Graveyard
[*]Introduced weapon-specific perks, randomly applied to gun pickups
[*]Added a new relic that can be acquired when beating the Countess; this increases the levels of weapons you find

[*]Explosive barrels now only deal 20 damage to the player (they still deal 100 damage to enemies)

[*]The Power Totem now gives 8 health for each upgrade (instead of 2)

[*]Fixed a bug where the essence selection screen could not be used with gamepad (works with the D-Pad now)
[*]Fixed a bug where Vengeance homing projectiles would just hover in the air if there were no enemies left
[*]Fixed a bug where jumping and falling sounds would play during the loading screen[/list]

So long, friends. I hope you will enjoy the new changes! 
Ede out!

notes.title: 🔥 Update 0.445 adds the Forgotten Graveyard, a new Boss, Weapon, Enemies & more
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44325770/ec6d330c9c2c440aa6798b9f166ab97ddad70163.jpg[/img]

Greetings Soulslingers!

We have just released our first major update, The Forgotten Graveyard Update. In this patch, we are introducing a completely new realm, a new boss, a new weapon, new enemies to defeat and much more. We also made some balancing changes and fixed some bugs.  

[b]Forgotten Graveyard[/b]

Welcome to the Forgotten Graveyard! Are you ready to face the challenges that await you in a realm controlled by The Countess? Be prepared to fight ferocious monsters that you have never faced before to reach her. 

But if you manage to defeat her, you will be rewarded with her precious weapon, the Night Quartet. It operates differently from the other weapons you were able to use before, as it has a cooldown mechanism. This means that you can fire it as many times as you want without having to reload it, but be cautious about overheating it! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44325770/dbdddcda0615e8e3f2cdc42d0fc81848650ff158.png[/img]
[b]Blood Essence and Spectral Essence[/b]

Blood Essence is used for a set of powerful new abilities focused on absorbing the blood and spirits of your opponents to heal yourself, deal more damage, or enhance your ultimate skill. However, some of these abilities are consumed upon use. Utilizing the Blood Essence abilities can give you an edge in challenging battles and help you in seemingly impossible fights. 

To obtain Spectral Essence skills, you must venture into the treacherous 'Forgotten Graveyard'. These abilities are unique and powerful, for example, you can unlock explosive homing projectiles that can hunt down your targets and deal massive damage, or trade in your dash for a double jump. 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/X7F9bk8r/New-Abilities-Gif.gif[/img]

[b]Power Totem[/b]

The Power Totem is another new addition to Limbo. You can now spend the tears you've collected on permanent upgrades that will help you in your fight against the Cartel. You can upgrade as much as you want to get even stronger, as there is no end to the Power Totem—however, the cost  increases each time. 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/qRwB9TpG/Powertotem.gif[/img]

[u][b]This is the complete changelog for update 0.445:[/b][/u]


[b]NEW FEATURES AND IMPROVEMENTS:[/b][list]
[*]New realm: the 'Forgotten Graveyard'
[*]Added four new enemies
[*]New boss: 'The Countess' can be defeated at the end of the Forgotten Graveyard
[*]New weapon: the 'Night Quartet' is a cooldown-based 4-shooter that you can loot from the Countess
[*]Added the 'Spectral Essence' and all its related abilities and perks, you can access these in the Forgotten Graveyard
[*]Added the 'Blood Essence' and all its related abilities and perks; you can access these after beating the King's Guard for the first time
[*]You can now construct the 'Power Totem' at Haven; this allows you to upgrade Soulslinger's stats infinitely
[*]You can now construct the 'Orb of the Seer' at Haven, this keeps track of your stats and efficiency
[*]Replaced the visuals of the Poison Bullet explosion with a much better looking and more impactful visual effect
[*]Movement with a gamepad is now based on a curve and has a deadzone, so moving the left or right thumbsticks will now respect the strength of movement
[*]All missing items are now indicated in the Workshop, along with instructions on how to get them
[/list]
[b]BALANCE:[/b][list]
[*]Reduced the length of time dilation caused by the Darkened Moment ability
[*]All AOE dash abilities now trigger 100% of the time
[*]Removed Healing Shards as separate rewards, these became redundant (the Blood Essence has the exact same perk)
[*]Healing Shards can still be acquired as boss rewards or at the challenge arena
[*]Reduced the health of the Cursed King from 9000 to 6000
[*]Reduced the impact circle of the stones thrown by Cartel Brutes
[*]Reduced the gravity of the Ardent Assassin's fireball projectile, making it slightly more effective[/list]
[b]BUGFIXES:[/b][list]
[*]Fixed a bug which caused massive stutter at cut-scene transitions when DLSS was enabled
[*]Fixed a bug where the crafting screen status was not immediately updated upon collecting resources from the Bestiary
[*]Fixed a bug where the hidden gate downside obtained with a Death perk would never reset after loading a saved game
[*]Fixed a bug where saving the game immediately after beating the Cursed King would result in a corrupted saved game
[*]Fixed a bug where an empty or corrupted perk would be displayed when picking up a reward
[*]Tons of visual fixes and tweaks to make sure VFX doesn't overwhelm the screen
[*]Improved the map selection algorithm to make sure maps are repeated less frequently[/list]

Please let us know what you think!  

So long, friends. Have a great time! 
Ede out!

[b]New Realm: The 'Forgotten Graveyard'[/b]

notes.title: 🔥 Soulslinger Roadmap Update 0.422 adds "Gunplay 2.0" and more!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44325770/4f273e2a7c5c6dfec13c4e344601ab17db55f8dd.jpg[/img]

Howdy, Soulslingers!

Ede here, straight from the forge of [b]Soulslinger: Envoy of Death[/b], bringing you some good news: As announced in last weeks update posting, it's about time for the very first Early Access Roadmap update and for you to get your hands on the improved and enhanced "[b]Gunplay 2.0[/b]"!

Update 0.422 adds overhauled recoil animations including recoil in ADS, "flying numbers" that appear when dealing damage to enemies, more noticeable impact visual effects and audio cues, improved enemy AI, balance changes, and many more:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dI1AWdZLoyg

[u][b]This is the complete changelog for update 0.422:[/b][/u]

[b]New features and improvements:[/b]
[list][*] Added a new battle arena to the Land of Memories
[*] Added 36 new conversations for Dead Eye McGee
[*] Added "flying numbers" to be able to track damage dealt
[*] Improved weapon movement and physics
[*] Improved revolver recoil animations
[*] Improved movement and jumping physics of Soulslinger
[*] There is proper recoil during ADS now
[*] Added impact VFX and audio when enemies get hit
[*] Fire and electric dashes have been replaced with brand new, more useful shockwave abilities
[*] Improved enemy reaction animations to getting hit
[*] Improved enemy AI, enemies no longer get stuck on level geometry
[*] The dash screen VFX has been replaced with a more prominent animated effect
[*] Gamepad buttons will now be displayed instead of keyboard prompts if a gamepad is used[/list]
[b]Balance:[/b]
[list][*] ADS has a much smaller movement speed penalty
[*] Reduced player dash distance a bit
[*] Vastly reduced the health of Cartel Brutes
[*] His own explosive bullets no longer hurt Soulslinger
[*] Electric bullets are stronger, also affect explosive barrels and bonus crates now
[*] Increased melee damage
[*] Gloaming Strike provides a greater bonus to melee damage[/list]
[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list][*] Fixed numerous gamepad-related bugs
[*] Polished existing maps for smoother navigation
[*] Fixed a bug where the Cursed King would not be visible while leaving during his first introduction
[*] Fixed a bug in the cave arena where enemies would get stuck next to the stairs
[*] Fixed a bug where the pirate's double damage bullet would not appear in the inventory
[*] Fixed a bug where in the temple yard arena, enemies could spawn or teleport above the ceiling
[*] Fixed a bug in the "hanged skeleton" arena where Spectral Shardstones could spawn outside the playable area
[*] Fixed a bug where part of the animated sky was not visible
[*] Fixed a rare bug where some enemies would just automatically get killed
[*] Fixed a bug where enemies would hop up stairs instead of walking
[*] Eliminated several cases of enemies unnecessarily jumping
[*] Fixed backslashes before each apostrophe in the French language
[*] You can now close the difficulty selection window in Haven without making a choice
[*] Fixed a camera bug in Dead Eye McGee's introduction cut-scene[/list]
Please let me know what you think about the update and its contents!  if you have any feedback, please post it in the comments, in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2429240?snr=1_5_9_][b]Steam Community[/b][/url] or on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/evy7rfjdUX][b]Discord server[/b][/url].

So long, friends. Have fun with "Gunplay 2.0"!
Ede out!

notes.title: Soulslinger in a nutshell: That's awaiting you with the Early Access release!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44325770/1df43a9fe1e656409d7fc2f048ec9eb326874f37.jpg[/img]

Greetings fellow Soulslingers!

Tomorrow is finally the Early Access release of Soulslinger! Woohoo! And while we're feeling extremely proud of it and confident that you'll have a great time (and can't wait to share it with you!), I think it's always a good idea to lay out the features of the game in black and white, so you know what to expect before spending your hard-earned money!

So without further ado, this is the [b]Soulslinger: Envoy of Death[/b] Early Access release in a nutshell:

[list][*] Soulslinger is a roguelite first person shooter
[*] The game will release 8am PST / 5pm CET 
[*] We worked on the game for 3 years so far
[*] The Early Access release contains roughly one-third of all planned game content
[*] It is based on the latest version of Unreal Engine 5
[*] The Early Access release includes the first realm, "Land of Memories"
[*] It includes the first intermediate boss fight as well as the first "real" boss fight
[*] You will fight 11 various enemies in Limbo
[*] A total number of three weapons is included (two revolvers, a shotgun)
[*] There is a total of 4 essences with over 40 active abilities and passive skills
[*] You are going to visit 20 different maps
[*] There are 22 unlockable Steam achievements included (good hunting!)
[*] It should take you 3-5 hours to defeat the boss for the first time
[*] Doing so will unlock two additional levels of difficulty ("Difficult" and "Insane")
[*] The first difficulty adds a new type of enemy and opponents in general have more health, but you are rewarded with an additional craftable relic for completing this!
[*] When playing on "Insane" you will die by only one hit (good luck!)[/list]
That's it for now! That's [b]Soulslinger: Envoy of Death[/b]. Should we be lucky enough that you deem our humble opus worthy of your hard-earned money, we really really hope you enjoy playing it as much as we’ve enjoyed making it for you.

Whilst the Early Access phase we are going to add the additional content through a number of four major content updates, joined by QoL updates based on your community/player feedback.

[b]This is what the Early Access roadmap looks like:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44325770/849f3400839579c06ba41e70ef1248899fdb7d08.png[/img]

And that's it for today, friends. See you tomorrow in the realms of Limbo!
Ede out!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44325770/05cfd5d1e7f01b6e7edf9f9b87d952f8ef73ad36.jpg[/img]

Happy Monday, fellow gunslingers! 🤠

Once again, it's about time for the fabulous [b]Steam Next Fest[/b]! Until October 16 hundreds of demos are live here on Steam, connected to hundreds of streams, developer specials, and much more. Exciting times for sure, and you definitely don't want to miss this! 

And [b]Soulslinger: Envoy of Death[/b] is aboard for Steam Next Fest as well! Just scroll down and click the green "Download" button to get your hands on the demo. And as promised, we updated the demo for Steam Next Fest! This is the complete list of new and updated features, balance changes and bugfixes:

[b]NEW / UPDATED FEATURES:[/b]
[list][*] New relic: the Purse of Prosperity, you can get the schematic from the pirate vendor
[*] A new pre-rendered cinematic teases the story's main mystery
[*] Added boss stages -- the King's Guard each have a secondary boss phase which brings new, more powerful spells for them!
[*] Added more weight to enemy movements, replaced several animations and added sfx and vfx to enhance this
[*] Added FOV option
[*] Summoner enemies have improved AI, they can now rush in and strike you down with an AOE attack
[*] Added invert Y option
[*] Redesigned and added the shader compilation screen back into the game, should alleviate the remaining stutters
[*] Added tutorial for fast reload[/list]
[b]BALANCE CHANGES:[/b]
[list][*] Poison will now expire after a while
[*] Corrupted Decoy has less health (i.e. enemies kill it faster). Its own automatic expiration still happens at the same speed.
[*] Fire explosions deal more damage (instead of 1.5x normal damage, it now deals 2x)
[*] Reduced shotgun spread for more accuracy / usability
[*] Reduced shotgun second bullet bonus damage, but increased base damage
[*] Ultimate abilities are now recharged by successful shots instead of time and will not be auto-recharged at the end of a battle
[*] Increased the health of both King's Guard bosses
[*] Reduced the aim assist amount[/list]
[b]BUGFIXES:[/b]
[list][*] Fixed the "Fatal error!" crash
[*] Fixed the bug where the game started in a different resolution than the main screen, only showing a quarter of the full game
[*] Fixed an exploit where you could cause enemies to deal 0% damage
[*] Fixed a bug where Shock Bullet did not remain available after use with Overload
[*] Fixed several cases where stunning an enemy did not always interrupt their current action
[*] Fixed enemies spawning in walls in the temple cave arena
[*] Fixed a bug where enemies were not following you down into the mines in the mine arena
[*] After a melee attack, a reload is now immediately initiated if ammo is at zero
[*] Causing an animation glitch by spamming the melee key is no longer possible
[*] Fixed a bug where Amulet of accuracy did not work with a shotgun as some bullets would definitely miss -- this is now handled per shot, not per bullet!
[*] Reckless recovery now triggers on all other kills, not just bullet kills
[*] Fixed missing water material in the initial area
[*] Restricted regular in-game dialogue after Death's initial convo to prevent overlap between Soulslinger's voice lines
[*] Fixed a graphical glitch with the gate travel VFX
[*] Added a black, fullscreen background behind cut-scene videos so you can't see "behind" videos on certain resolutions
[*] Various minor UI tweaks and fixes[/list]
In the case you played the demo already, it would be awesome if you could give it another try and let us know what you think about the improvements. And if you haven't played the demo yet, that's great! Please play it and let us know what you think [url=https://forms.office.com/pages/responsepage.aspx?id=ig2_bxffr06YCBnmIw4l2xOI9aekmFRNtw8pkHvw2m5UQlZJSEpSQ05EQ0o4UVFFQzBYOUhCTjZSRCQlQCN0PWcu][b]in this survey[/b][/url].

If you're having a good time, please do us a favor and click on "Follow" as well as on "Add To Your Wishlist". That would really help us a lot. ❤️

And as you are in the western-inspired shooting mood already, you should also take a look at the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1796220/Laika_Aged_Through_Blood/][b]Laika: Aged Through Blood[/b][/url] demo. Enjoy!

Happy Steam Next Fest to all of you!

notes.title: Souslinger demo update #2: performance optimization, melee attack, and more!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44325770/13546c6804f1fb935c5f3ac9316b6c9555c1b9cd.jpg[/img]

Happy Monday, fellow gunslingers! 🤠

Let's keep it short and simple: I've published another major update to the [b]Soulslinger: Envoy of Death[/b] demo the last weekend! And instead of making big speeches here, I'll just let the changelog speak for itself:


[b]OPTIMIZATIONS:[/b]
[list][*] Game consumes 3-5GB RAM consistently (instead of the previous 8-10GB)
[*] Game runs at 100+ FPS on high-end machines, can even work with a GTX 1060 on medium-high graphics
[*] Instead of all the micro-stutters, we have opted to make the game freeze for 1-2 seconds when travelling through a gate, while we display "LOADING" -- this makes you wait a bit at each travel, but makes the game a lot smoother in all other situations![/list]
[b]GAMEPLAY:[/b]
[list][*] Ability cooldown is now time-based instead of kill-based, allowing you to reuse abilities multiple times even throughout a single battle!
[*] Each battle now consists of multiple enemy waves
[*] Added a melee attack (default key: V) that deals moderate damage and pushes enemies back a bit
[*] Added invert mouse option
[*] Tons of bugfixes[/list]
[b]KNOWN ISSUE:[/b]
[list][*] At the moment, we are aware of a "Fatal error!" crash that can occur sometimes, we are currently in the process of investigating this. Expect a hotfix soon that will resolve this![/list]

notes.title: Thanks for playing our Soulslinger demo + update coming soon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44325770/e5fd669cb79ea1ccaf3c23f14c853d18b5e8c62b.jpg[/img]

Happy Friday, fellow gunslingers! 🤠

First things first: Thank you all so much for playing the [b]Soulslinger: Envoy of Death[/b] demo, and for providing some very valuable feedback on all channels! We are listening, reading, and collecting it everywhere: at gamescom, in the comments, the Steam Community Hub, the survey, on Discord, etc.

[h2][b]You all are fire![/b] 🔥[/h2]

Because this is exactly the feedback that is super important for us to prepare the game for release this year. We have created a to-do-list with a bunch of changes, fixes and optimizations, including the following:

[list][*] Expect [b]updated enemy AI[/b]: enemies will have additional behaviors and will be able to react to more situations in a natural way! (Eg. the archer enemy will perform a melee attack when you get close instead of running away, or the basic swarmer enemy will be able to dash closer to you)
[*] [b]Fast reload[/b]: during reload, you'll be able to press the "Fire" button at the right time to instantly complete the reload! If you time this right, you'll be able to cut the reload time in half, or less!
[*] Update to how Soulslinger handles: his [b]movements will feel more dynamic[/b] and will react to your input faster!
[*] [b]Smoother animations[/b]: enemy animations will appear to be smoother (i.e. no more choppy animations!)
[*] We're [b]revising enemy compositions[/b], discarding the ones that were boring to play against and amping up the ones we felt were a good fit!
[*] We're also in the process of [b]rebalancing enemy health and ability powers[/b], once again to make sure it all feels better to play![/list]
We will update the demo, and of course keep you up to date here on the Steam page. As these are some significant changes, please bear with us, this might take some time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44325770/ba6fd475a118bcfca7f198a8da5d98c88c85513c.png[/img]
[i]Working on map optimization[/i]

In case you've already played the Soulslinger demo and haven't left us your feedback yet, please do so in the [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2429240]Steam Community Hub[/url][/b], on [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/gJeK5DJTva]Discord[/url][/b] or run through our [b][url=https://forms.office.com/pages/responsepage.aspx?id=ig2_bxffr06YCBnmIw4l2xOI9aekmFRNtw8pkHvw2m5UQlZJSEpSQ05EQ0o4UVFFQzBYOUhCTjZSRCQlQCN0PWcu]feedback survey[/url][/b]. No feedback will remain unread. Promise!

Talk to you very soon, friends. Have a great time!
Ede out!
